content.text:
Welch Allyn / Hillrom / Baxter ophthalmology tools are mainly **handheld diagnostic eye-exam instruments**, especially ophthalmoscopes and diagnostic sets.

Common Welch Allyn ophthalmic tools include:

- **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope** — wide-view direct ophthalmoscope for retinal exams; current sets feature PanOptic Plus with Quick Eye alignment technology. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/?utm_source=openai))  
- **3.5 V Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** — classic direct ophthalmoscope with Coaxial optics, LED lamp technology, polarizing filter, and multiple aperture combinations. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/3-5v-coaxial-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai))  
- **3.5 V AutoStep Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** — coaxial ophthalmoscope with 68 lenses in single-diopter steps for more precise focusing. ([hillrom.ca](https://www.hillrom.ca/en/products/3-5v-autostep-coaxial-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Retinoscopes** — used for objective refraction; often included in Welch Allyn diagnostic set categories. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/diagnostic-sets/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Diagnostic sets** — kits combining eye/ENT tools such as ophthalmoscopes, otoscopes, retinoscopes, rechargeable handles, chargers, and cases. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/diagnostic-sets/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Binocular indirect ophthalmoscope accessories / older Welch Allyn BIO equipment** — less commonly discussed than their handheld scopes, but Welch Allyn has supported BIO-related products and power sources. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/content/dam/hillrom-aem/us/en/marketing/products/binocular-indirect-ophthalmoscope/documents/usermanual_20090303_BIO_power_source.pdf?utm_source=openai))  

If you’re buying for **medical/PA/nursing school**, the usual Welch Allyn set is an **otoscope + ophthalmoscope diagnostic set**. If you’re buying for **optometry/ophthalmology practice**, you may want to compare Welch Allyn handheld scopes with slit-lamp lenses, BIOs, and retinal imaging tools depending on your use case.
